description: Erection of one new residential infill house to the rear of the site
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-092e263d-7fff-eeb7-5b64-25d535917b7a"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;text-align: justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;padding:0pt 5pt 0pt 5pt;"><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-decoration: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">In the absence of a completed legal agreement securing the required £50,000 affordable housing contribution, the proposal fails to make appropriate provision towards affordable housing in the borough. The development is therefore contrary to Policy LP33 (Affordable Housing) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033, the Planning Contributions SPD (2020), and Policy H4 of the London Plan (2021).</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-aab4a6c6-7fff-3463-4aa5-b18f59376ece"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;text-align: justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;padding:0pt 5pt 0pt 5pt;"><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-decoration: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">In the absence of a completed legal agreement securing a financial contribution to offset the residual carbon emissions of the development, the proposal fails to demonstrate compliance with the net zero carbon requirements of the development plan. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy LP54 (Overheating and Decentralised Energy) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 and Policy SI2 (Minimising Greenhouse Gas Emissions) of the London Plan (2021).</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-15d92f72-7fff-2e9d-bda4-373367f2fa83"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;text-align: justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;padding:0pt 5pt 0pt 5pt;"><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-decoration: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">The proposed development, by reason of its siting, form, scale and incongruous backland character, would result in harm to the setting and significance of the Grade II listed building and would fail to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the Clissold Park Conservation Area. The proposal therefore fails to accord with Policies LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character) and LP3 (Designated Heritage Assets) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033, Policies D3, D4 and HC1 of the London Plan (2021), and the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-a42feb57-7fff-a834-8873-94688f781d81"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;text-align: justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;padding:0pt 5pt 0pt 5pt;"><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-decoration: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">In the absence of a completed legal agreement securing on-site measures to achieve a minimum 10% Biodiversity Net Gain, the proposal fails to demonstrate that adequate BNG enhancement would be delivered. The development is therefore contrary to Policy LP13 (Green Infrastructure and Biodiversity) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033, Policy G6 of the London Plan (2021), and the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-d63e92c1-7fff-4ebd-ef48-31b884cff028"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;text-align: justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;padding:0pt 5pt 0pt 5pt;"><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-decoration: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">The proposed development, by reason of its scale, siting and proximity to site boundaries, would result in an increased sense of enclosure and loss of outlook to neighbouring occupiers. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy LP2 (Amenity) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033, Policy D6 of the London Plan (2021), and the Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2009).</span></p>

<p>In the absence of a suitable undertaking to secure that the occupiers of the new residential units would not be able to apply for on street parking permit, the proposals would have an adverse impact on street parking conditions, highway safety and sustainable modes of transport, contrary to Policies T1 and T4 of the London Plan (2021) and Hackney Local Plan Policies LP43 and LP45.</p>
